notes:
The sheet records cohomology formulas for a procyclic group generated by f=frob^q, followed by integral and rational Tate coefficients over F_q and formulas over Spec Z. It marks the integral comparison “non canoniquement” and adds three brown “mod p-grps? / p-groupes?” qualifications and “(id)”; the question marks remain. The prime on M′_π and the unexplained 4/! mark after Q_l are retained from the ink without assigning them a mathematical correction. The wavy under-marks on the lower Q and Z are retained, including the Q under-mark on the right-hand side of HH¹(F_q,Q~)=Q~. The H/HH variation in the integral brace and bottom margin is also retained. The lower Spec Z claims and the open-restriction assertion are reported, not independently proved. An older Q overwritten by Z, a cancellation beneath n≢0, and a small hatched mark beneath “si” are included. Archive number 172; no date.

173.N1 (limited algebraic check of the upper kernel/cokernel notation): (1−f)m=m−f(m), so its kernel is exactly the set of m satisfying m=f(m); its image is the subgroup of elements m−f(m), and its cokernel is M/(1−f)M by the quotient definition. This verifies those displayed algebraic descriptions only; it supplies no independent proof of the page’s continuous-cohomology or motivic-cohomology calculations.
